name: Back Extension (Weighted)
instructions: Set the pad of a back-extension bench just below your hip crease and hook your heels under the rollers.
Hold a plate against your chest with crossed arms and start with your torso hanging down, spine neutral.
Raise your torso by squeezing your glutes until your body forms a straight line.
Pause briefly without leaning back past neutral.
Lower under control to the start.
longevityNotes: Hip-hinge strength protects the lower back in every lift, from groceries to grandchildren. Strong glutes and hamstrings are the engine of walking, climbing, and standing up.
overview: A loaded back extension that strengthens the spinal erectors, glutes and hamstrings through hip extension.

sources.title: Original to the LIFT knowledge base

commonMistakes: Hyperextending the lower back at the top
Rounding the upper back at the bottom
safetyNotes: Keep the weight light enough that you can stop at a neutral spine; skip with acute low-back pain.
